findings.summary: T-R1-12..16 all closed [x]. Three Lakeview dashboards deployed and ACTIVE in DEV: Network Overview, Gas Analytics, Hot Contracts. SQL validation passed on all Gold MV source tables.

DABs v0.270.0 / TF provider v1.88.0 does not support resources.queries, resources.alerts, or resources.genie_spaces as terraform-managed types. Alert and Genie bundles sync files only — workspace query/alert/Genie-space objects must be created manually or via DABs upgrade.
findings.detail_md: Affects T-R1-12 (alert query not auto-created) and T-R1-14 (Genie space not auto-created). Alert SQL validated directly via SQLA API. FQNs validated via SQL COUNT(*). Escalate to devops-engineer for DABs/provider version upgrade.
findings.fix_recommendation: Upgrade databricks CLI and TF provider to a version supporting genie_spaces and sqla alerts as first-class resources, OR create these objects manually in the Databricks workspace UI.

findings.summary: lvdash.json files use hardcoded dev. catalog prefix — not portable to hml/prod targets. Acceptable for DEV-only deploy; multi-env portability requires templated generation.
findings.fix_recommendation: Generate environment-specific lvdash.json files or use a DABs bundle templating approach for multi-env catalog references.
